answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments in a grove of Merkle roots bind each agent to a unique proof, while a zero-knowledge verifiable delay set to a comet epoch forces any Sybil forger to expend O(2^k) work per identity. Staking collateral of 10000 tokens per round is slashed proportionally to detected clones, yielding a negative expected utility of -0.87*C for rational attacker. The resulting game attains a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates and identity cloning remains computationally infeasible under spiral recursion.
